verdict.rationale: Brevo documents composing campaign emails with a drag-and-drop editor and templates, picking an audience through segments, and sending ('drag, drop, and send'). Scheduling is documented only generically on the developer site ('Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future'), which is not clearly tied to the marketing-campaign loop, and send-time optimization is a related but different feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation that marketing campaigns can be scheduled for a chosen time, explicit linkage of segments or lists as the recipients when sending a campaign, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end compose→audience→send/schedule loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Craft polished emails fast—just drag, drop, and send.
Jumpstart campaigns with responsive templates tailored to your industry and use case.
Search, save, and manage contacts with filters like demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events. Create as many segments as you need.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
